official.status_note: The official page (updated 29 June 2026) publishes the 2026 intake with an application deadline of July 01, 2026; selection results were announced on 16 July 2026 and re-registration ran 17-24 July 2026. No 2027 intake window is published at the verification date.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Complete exemption from tuition fees (UKT) during all 8 academic semesters of S1 study.
benefits: 100% tuition fee waiver: complete exemption from tuition fees (UKT) during all 8 academic semesters of S1 study
Monthly living allowance of IDR 4,700,000 transferred directly to help cover off-campus housing and general living costs
One-time arrival settlement allowance of IDR 10,000,000 paid upon landing to secure private off-campus accommodation
Round-trip international flight at cost: economy class ticket from the capital city of the home nation to Jakarta (CGK), including local travel to the ITB Bandung campus
Basic health insurance covering necessary inpatient care, outpatient treatment and accidental emergencies within Indonesia (excluding aesthetic care)
Visa fees: waiver or direct reimbursement for standard student visa application and regulatory processing; financial support applies exclusively to the individual awardee with no family dependencies
eligibility: Applicants must be Non-Indonesian Citizens (Non-WNI) and hold a valid passport or official citizenship from one of the designated ASEAN and Asia-Pacific regions or African partner countries
Must possess a 12-Year High School Diploma or equivalent official senior high school credentials; anyone who already holds or is pursuing an S1 degree is ineligible
Minimum cumulative high school grades equivalent to a GPA of 3.00 out of a 4.00 scale
Valid English proficiency certificate obtained within the last 2 years with the minimum thresholds published by ITB
Certified medical report required, no active military service membership, and a clean criminal record verified by home country authorities

Awardees must not marry or engage in legal marriages with Indonesian citizens, permanent residents or fellow scholarship recipients during the study timeline, and may not bring dependents or family members
requirements: Complete registration through ITB's centralized, online financial aid management portal
Provide a valid English proficiency certificate obtained within the last 2 years
Provide a certified medical report, and evidence of no active military service and a clean criminal record verified by home country authorities
A non-diplomatic passport valid at least until 31 December 2027 must be scanned and uploaded
documents: Valid passport scan (non-diplomatic, valid at least until 31 December 2027)
12-year high school diploma: legalized high school graduation certificate and transcript documentation
School recommendation letter signed by the principal or proper counsellor from the previous high school
English test result certificate (TOEFL ITP, TOEFL iBT, IELTS or Duolingo)
Personal profile video uploaded as a YouTube link explaining background, reasons for studying in Indonesia and academic goals at ITB
Embassy recommendation letter (optional) from the Indonesian Embassy (KBRI) or Consulate General, submitted only if available
selection_criteria: Document submission and online registration stage followed by a finalization stage
ITB academic qualification (AQ) and English-language qualification (ELQ) simulation stage, with results to be informed later
For the 2026 intake: ITB ELQ test on 6 July 2026, drawing test for Architecture on 7 July 2026, drawing test for Art and Design (FSRD) on 7 July 2026, and the ITB AQ test on 8 July 2026
Announcement of selection results on 16 July 2026, followed by re-registration on 17-24 July 2026
coverage: 100% tuition fee waiver (UKT) for all 8 academic semesters of S1 study
One-time arrival settlement allowance of IDR 10,000,000
Round-trip economy flight at cost from the home capital to Jakarta plus local travel to the ITB Bandung campus
Basic health insurance for inpatient, outpatient and accidental emergencies in Indonesia
Visa fee waiver or direct reimbursement
application_method: Register and complete the application through ITB's centralized online financial aid management portal
Complete the application form fields: personal information, academic profile and language scores, first and second programme choices, and the personal statement video link
Scan all documents into clear digital formats with a maximum file size of 300kb each and upload them
Complete the finalization stage and the ITB AQ and ELQ simulation stages for the relevant intake
official.application_route: Online application through ITB's centralized online financial aid management portal
official.citizenship_residency: Non-Indonesian citizens from the designated ASEAN, Asia-Pacific and African partner countries; recipients must arrange private off-campus accommodation as ITB provides no dormitory or hostel support
official.international_eligibility: Yes - restricted to non-Indonesian citizens from designated ASEAN, Asia-Pacific and African partner countries
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: S1 (undergraduate) programmes at ITB; a compulsory Indonesian language course is part of the ITB curriculum and there is no separate BIPA preparatory programme before S1 studies
official.duration: All 8 academic semesters of S1 study, within a maximum 5-year study cycle for retaining scholarship status
official.description: The ITB International Undergraduate Scholarship is a fully-funded grant for selected young talents from designated partner countries in ASEAN, Asia-Pacific and Africa to study at Indonesia's leading technological university, covering 100% of tuition fees for all eight semesters, a monthly living allowance of IDR 4,700,000, an arrival settlement of IDR 10,000,000, round-trip economy flights, basic health insurance and visa fees.
official.program_type: University-funded fully funded scholarship targeted at partner countries
official.english_requirement: TOEFL ITP 550, TOEFL iBT 63 or IELTS 6.0; an equivalent Duolingo English Test or official school statements confirming English as the primary medium of instruction are acceptable. The certificate must have been obtained within the last 2 years.

verification.notes: The 100% tuition waiver, the IDR 4,700,000 monthly living allowance, the IDR 10,000,000 arrival settlement, the round-trip flight, health insurance and visa-fee benefits, the eligibility and language benchmarks, the document set (including the passport validity of 31 December 2027) and the 2026 intake timeline were confirmed on ITB's official financial aid page, marked as updated 29 June 2026. The 2026 application deadline of 1 July 2026 has passed and no 2027 dates are published.

applicant_utility.summary: This is one of the few scholarships that covers tuition, living costs, flights, insurance and visa fees, but it is administered on a strict 5 July-1 July cycle that has already closed for 2026, so the next opportunity is the following year's call. Two administrative details sink applications: the passport must be non-diplomatic and valid at least until 31 December 2027, and every upload must be under 300 kb, so plan document scanning in advance. There is no dormitory - the IDR 4,700,000 monthly stipend is expected to cover private off-campus housing in Bandung, so budget realistically for rent.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Recent 12-year high-school graduates from designated ASEAN, Asia-Pacific and African partner countries with a GPA of at least 3.00/4.00 and an English certificate obtained within the last two years.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your country is on the published ASEAN and Asia-Pacific or African partner list
Check your passport is non-diplomatic and valid at least until 31 December 2027; renew early if not
Take or locate an English test result dated within the last 24 months meeting TOEFL ITP 550, TOEFL iBT 63 or IELTS 6.0
Obtain a legalized high school diploma and transcript, plus a school recommendation letter signed by the principal or counsellor
Record the personal profile video on YouTube explaining background, motivation for Indonesia and goals at ITB
Compress every upload to under 300 kb before the portal window opens
common_rejection_risks: Already holding or pursuing an S1 degree, which makes the applicant ineligible
A GPA below 3.00 out of 4.00 in cumulative high school grades
An English certificate older than two years, which the rules explicitly reject
Uploading scans larger than the 300 kb limit or unreadable passport copies
Missing the drawing tests for Architecture and Art/Design, where applicable
Attempting to change programme or transfer universities later, which is prohibited once awarded
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: No dormitory or hostel support is provided, so any private rent above what IDR 4,700,000 per month covers in Bandung falls to the student, and the flight benefit is at cost with no family coverage.
document_audit: The recommendation letter must come from the principal or proper counsellor of the previous high school, not a university referee
The embassy recommendation letter is optional and should only be added if available
The personal statement is a YouTube video link, not a written essay, so set it up before the portal opens
A certified medical report and clean criminal record verification from home-country authorities are mandatory
alerts: The published 2026 window closed on 1 July 2026 with results on 16 July 2026; the next intake window is not yet announced, so monitor the page from early June
The marital restriction is unusual and binding: awardees must not marry Indonesian citizens, permanent residents or fellow recipients during the study period
Awardees are strictly prohibited from part-time or full-time work, including business activity, under Indonesian immigration rules
Accepting any other scholarship concurrently results in immediate termination
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Register on ITB's financial aid portal, upload passport, legalized diploma, recommendation, English certificate and video link under 300 kb each, then finalize and sit the AQ/ELQ stages.
